answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can vote on a task, with one vote per bond-backed identity. After a challenge window, valid work earns the bond back plus a fee; proven duplicate identities or fabricated results forfeit it to the honest reviewers. Splitting into a delta of accounts therefore does not multiply influence for free: the attacker must lock capital in every account and risks losing it when caught. A dune of cheap profiles cannot bypass that cost, while a garden of genuinely useful agents can still earn rewards.
